name: com.yevhenii.purser
description: Drop-in in-app purchases for Unity, verified by your self-hosted Purser server on SpacetimeDB: Google Play and App Store through Unity IAP 5.4+ (installed separately), Amazon Appstore, Steam, Stripe and Xsolla. Server-side validation, consume/acknowledge, restore, customer info with access levels, paywalls.

samples.description: Minimal shop: buy, restore and show access levels (IMGUI, no extra dependencies).
Bridge from AmazonStoreAdapter to Amazon's Appstore SDK Unity plugin (Unity IAP 5 has no Amazon store).
Bridge from HuaweiStoreAdapter to the HMS Unity Plugin's In-App Purchases (Unity IAP has no Huawei store).
Bridge from SamsungStoreAdapter to Samsung's IAP Unity plugin (Unity IAP has no Samsung store).
Bridge from MetaQuestStoreAdapter to the Meta XR Platform SDK's in-app purchases and user proof (Unity IAP has no Meta store).
Opens Telegram Stars invoices of TelegramStoreAdapter with Telegram.WebApp.openInvoice (WebGL jslib).
Bridge from SteamStoreAdapter to Steamworks.NET (MicroTxnAuthorizationResponse_t, SteamID, language).
Keep the game's own Unity IAP 4 or 5 code and report its purchases to Purser (ReportPurchaseAsync).
Tenjin analytics_installation_id and Firebase app_instance_id for the server's renewal, refund and Xsolla events.
